# EduPrimeX

> Multi-tenant school management ERP for schools, colleges, and coaching institutes — manage students, staff, attendance, fees, exams, timetables, and analytics from a single dashboard.

EduPrimeX is a SaaS platform built for Indian schools. It supports multiple schools on one dashboard, role-based portals for admins, teachers, and students, AI-powered report cards and analytics, WhatsApp/SMS automation, online and offline exams, fee collection with receipts, face-recognition attendance, and a 30-day free trial.
